Data quality step of the Load Data wizard

Source: R/wizard-data_quality.R
data_quality_ui.Rd

Shows the result of every data quality check on the loaded dataset as a list of rows, each marked as passed or as a warning, with an explanation in a tooltip. The checks come from run_all_quality_checks(). The user enters nothing here and nothing is saved to the dataset. A button in the card's toolbar downloads every issue found as an Excel workbook (write_quality_issues()). The step counts as complete when every check of severity "blocking" has passed (see step_quality_complete()).

Usage

data_quality_ui(id, i18n)

data_quality_server(id, cache, i18n)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

Value

data_quality_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: a card that holds the list of checks and the download button. data_quality_server() is called for its side effects and returns nothing useful.

Details

The rows are in three parts:

  • the blocking checks: the file and its sheets (always shown as passed, because the wizard cannot reach this step when the file could not be read), the admin sheet's columns, the required columns, a single country, a recognised country, districts across sheets, district consistency, and missing or invalid months;

  • the informational checks, which never block: population against reported births, reported live births equal to the population's live births in every month, indicators with no data, and month names written in more than one way;

  • the mapping checks, which never block: admin level 1 names that do not match the survey or the shapefile.

A row is left out when the check did not run. A dataset loaded already merged (a Stata file, or a saved copy without stored results) only has the checks that run on merged data.

One check is not part of this step: that every indicator the group needs is present. It runs when the user presses Finish, because it reads columns that only exist after the sheets are merged.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in the server of the Load Data screen, where `cache` is a reactive holding the dataset:
# the step's page, for wizard_steps_server(), and its server
panel <- list(key = "quality", ui = data_quality_ui(ns("data_quality"), i18n))
data_quality_server("data_quality", cache, i18n)
} # }
